objective: WHERE-NEXT-20261116-001#1 (coordinator go-ahead 2026-11-16; goals G15, G16). WHERE-NEXT found the learned where-and-what agent with memory beats re-tuned Novelty+ in flips at its training sizes but ties at 4x and loses at 16x. Hypothesis: its memory reads step counts (ages clipped at 1,000 steps, counts decayed over 50 steps) whose meaning changes with size. A 2x2 of memory reads (step-counted vs scale-free: ranks and ratios within the knot and the candidates) and curriculum (200-800 vs mixed to 3200), plus a cheaper what-only scale-free arm, tested with the same baselines and frozen win rule at rand 3200, 12800, 51200 and local 3200. Stop at the frozen rule.
